title: Sanlorenzo SL86
highlights: Recent works: new paint, audio upgrade, Starlink
Flybridge table converts to a sunpad
description:
This 2018 Sanlorenzo SL86 is fitted with stabiliser fins and has recently undergone extensive works, including new paint, an upgraded audio system and a new Starlink system, plus brand-new exterior cushions, awnings, mattresses and linen.

She presents as new, with four cabins for eight guests and a flybridge dining table that converts into a sunpad. VAT paid, she is lying in Antibes, France.
